explanation: Eta electroproduction threshold is W_thr = m_p + m_eta = 0.938272 + 0.54786 = 1.486132 GeV. The requested W = 1.52 GeV is about 34 MeV (~2.3%) above threshold, i.e. comfortably above, and Q2 = 0.6 GeV^2 and W = 1.52 GeV both lie well within the EtaMAID-2023 table grid (Q2: 0-5 GeV^2, W: 1.4856-6 GeV) used by eta/mpintp.inc, so no interpolation-range issue arises. cos(theta*) = -0.4 and phi* = 45 deg are ordinary values with no restrictions in the source. Used the eta/ (IzzyIllari fork) configuration with its default settings: model=3 (EtaMAID), full O(alpha) corrections, bmom=6.535 GeV (CLAS12 beam momentum), lepton=1 (electron), ivec=1 (detected recoil proton, eta undetected), vcut=0.166 GeV^2 (standard CLAS12 inelasticity cut). Note the kinematic inelasticity limit vmax = W^2 - m_eta^2 + m_p^2 - 2*W*m_p (eta/exclurad.F:253) works out to only ~0.038 GeV^2 at this point, well below vcut=0.166; the code already clamps vmax=min(vmax,cutv) (eta/exclurad.F:254), so this requires no correction to the input file -- it is handled automatically by the integration limits. Generated a single-point input.dat (npoi=1) following the format read by eta/exclurad.F (iphy, ll, bmom, tmom, lepton, ivec, cutv, npoi, then one line each of W/Q2/cos(theta*)/phi* values), which the program opens directly as './input.dat' in the working directory.
